wikitext: {{EpicodePrevNext| prevcode=PG10 | prevtitle=The Old Chateau | nextcode=PG12 | nexttitle=The Magma Stone | series=Pokémon Generations | colorscheme=Hoso}} {{EpisodeInfobox| epcode=PG11 | colorscheme=Hoso| title_en=The New World | title_ja=新しい世界 | title_ja_trans=The New World | release_method=Web release | screen=hd | broadcast_jp=December 22, 2016 | broadcast_us=November 4, 2016 | en_op=N/A | ja_op=N/A | ja_ed=N/A | olmteam=Team Kato | scenario=冨岡淳広 | storyboard=川越崇弘 | director=川越崇弘 | art=西村郁 | morecredits=no | epstaffpage=PG11-PG18 | footnotes=* ''[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UOIPUi5k6MA The New World]'' on the official English Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel. * {{BMGf|219662|Review thread on BMGf}} }} '''The New World''' (Japanese: '''新しい世界''' ''The New World'') is the eleventh episode of [[Pokémon Generations]]. It was first released on the official English Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel on November 4, 2016. It was uploaded to the official Japanese Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel on December 22, 2016. {{spoilers}} ==Blurb== With the beginnings of a new universe laid out before him, Cyrus of Team Galactic faces extreme opposition. But aid arrives in an unusual form. ==Plot== At the [[Spear Pillar]] on the summit of [[Mount Coronet|Mt. Coronet]], [[Team Galactic]]'s leader, [[Cyrus]], summons the [[Legendary Pokémon]] {{p|Dialga}} and {{p|Palkia}}, who appear though their portals. As they appear, the two Legendary Pokémon are tangled in the [[Red Chain]]s. As the two struggle, while {{tc|Commander}}s [[Mars]] and [[Jupiter]] watch from afar, Cyrus begins to reveal his plan about the creation of a new world, one that will have a new beginning, bringing the current world to an end. At the [[Team Galactic HQ]], Commander [[Saturn]] is observing the events from a giant screen. Cyrus addresses Dialga and Palkia, ordering them to give him their power in order to create a new world, and as the chains around them begin to tighten, they glow, releasing their energy to create cracks in the stone pillars and ground beneath them, causing a {{tc|Team Galactic Grunt}}'s {{p|Glameow}} to dart back, surprised. As the world around them begins to end, Mars and Jupiter compliment Cyrus as they're closer to achieving Team Galactic's goal, but an angry voice orders them to stop. Turning around, they notice that [[Cynthia]], the [[Sinnoh League]] {{pkmn|Champion}}, has arrived in order to prevent Team Galactic from continuing with their plan as she orders Cyrus to release Dialga and Palkia immediately. Spots of inky black start to cover the ground, growing larger and larger, creating vibrations that reach the Team Galactic HQ, until everything instantly comes to a stop. Everyone watches, waiting, but Cyrus smirks for a moment before watching a Pokémon emerge from the mass. The black, inky silhouette of {{p|Giratina}}'s {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Giratina|Altered Form}} rises. As all this occurs, the team back at HQ is watching, completely stunned. Cyrus refers to Giratina as the "Pokémon that comes from shadows", before having Dialga and Palkia attack it with {{m|Roar of Time}} and {{m|Spacial Rend}}, respectively. Easily dodging the attacks, Giratina retaliates with two {{m|Shadow Ball}}s that destroy the Red Chains, allowing Dialga and Palkia to escape. Next, Giratina turns its wrath on Cyrus, seemingly engulfing him. Once the smoke clears, Mars and Jupiter are screaming for Cyrus as the find that he has disappeared, along with the strange Pokémon. Back and the HQ, Saturn desperately tries to make contact with Cyrus. Lying on the ground, Cyrus comes around, noticing Giratina staring blankly at him. He begins commenting on the world he is now in and sarcastically asks Giratina if it is now satisfied after ruining his plans for a new world. Getting to his feet, Cyrus looks around at the [[Distortion World|strange world around him]], realizing that there is nothing to this world, nor is there anything there, and that the world he desired is exactly like this one. Turning to Giratina, he smirks as he ponders. Still attempting to make contact with Cyrus, Saturn finally picks up a signal and hears Cyrus saying that he doesn't want them to look for him. The signal is cut off, and Saturn's further requests for his boss's location don't get an answer. He finally takes off his headset, accepting Cyrus's final order. ==Major events== * [[Cyrus]] summons {{p|Dialga}} and {{p|Palkia}} at the [[Spear Pillar]]. * {{p|Giratina}} appears and frees Dialga and Palkia, then drags Cyrus into the [[Distortion World]]. * Cyrus decides to stay in the Distortion World with Giratina. ==Characters== ===Humans=== * [[Cynthia]] * [[Cyrus]] * [[Mars]] * [[Jupiter]] * [[Saturn]] * {{tc|Team Galactic Grunt}}s ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Garchomp}} ({{OP|Cynthia|Garchomp}}) * {{p|Glameow}} ({{tc|Team Galactic Grunt}}'s) * {{p|Stunky}} ({{tc|Team Galactic Grunt}}'s) * {{p|Dialga}} * {{p|Palkia}} * {{p|Giratina}} ({{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Giratina|Altered and Origin Forme}}) * {{p|Golbat}} (multiple) ==Trivia== * In {{pmin|South Korea}}, this episode was reordered as the tenth episode. ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color=FDBB99|bordercolor=FD7F4F |nl={{tt|De nieuwe wereld|The new world}} |fr_eu={{tt|Le nouveau monde|The new world}} |de={{tt|Die neue Welt|The new world}} |it={{tt|Un nuovo mondo|A new world}} |ko={{tt|새로운 세계|The New World}} |pt_br={{tt|O Novo Mundo|The New World}} |es_eu={{tt|Un mundo nuevo|A new world}} }} {{-}} {{EpicodePrevNext| prevcode=PG10 | prevtitle=The Old Chateau | nextcode=PG12 | nexttitle=The Magma Stone | series=Pokémon Generations | colorscheme=Hoso}} {{Project Anime notice}} [[Category:Pokémon Generations episodes|11]] [[Category:Episodes written by Atsuhiro Tomioka]] [[Category:Episodes by one-time storyboarders]] [[Category:Episodes by one-time directors]] [[Category:Episodes by one-time animation directors]] [[Category:Episodes which aired in the United States before Japan]] [[de:Pokémon Generationen Folge 11: Die neue Welt]] [[es:GEN11]] [[fr:PG11]] [[it:PG11]] [[ja:PG第11話]] [[zh:宝可梦世代 第11集]]
